services.desc: Single Rider ½ Hour - $25 1 Hour - $35 About It is a great way to get out on the water. This mellow, low impact sport is all the rage around the globe. services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: 30 minutes or 1 hour Single Rider 30 minutes: $85 1 Hour: $135.00 Double Rider 30 minutes: $90 1 Hour: $145.00 About Anyone born on or after January 1st, 1988 is required to have a permit to operate a watercraft in the state of Florida. But don't worry! We provide education courses and temporary permits down at the beach. The exam only takes a few minutes and isn't difficult. Just come on down to the beach and we'll get you going on the quick exam before you head out on your jet Captain your own Jet Ski and Cruise the Gulf of Mexico! From $90 · Ages 6+
